useCase.name: Run the staff and payroll reports, with the salary visibility rule applied to every one and to every export of one

intent.name: report.hr.run
intent.summary: Run a staff or payroll report — the directory, headcount, the payroll register, the bank transfer sheet, leave, staff on leave today, advances, joiners and leavers, appraisals — for the month, role and branch the reader sets. The salary visibility rule is applied to every one.

routesHere.text: is mahine ki bank transfer sheet bana do
routesHere.gloss: make this month's bank transfer sheet

routesHere.text: aaj kaun kaun se staff chutti pe hain?
routesHere.gloss: which staff are on leave today?

routesHere.text: staff advances jo abhi baqi hain unki report
routesHere.gloss: report of staff advances still outstanding

request.text: School Admin ko payroll mein salary bhi dikhao
request.gloss: show salary in the payroll to the School Admin too

routesElsewhere.note: Who may see a salary is decided in the visibility rule — UC-12-15 — and every report applies it rather than overriding it (BR-4).
Running the payroll the reports read happens in payroll.

request.text: bank sheet haath se bana lo
request.gloss: make the bank sheet by hand

routesElsewhere.note: The bank transfer sheet is produced from the approved payroll run, never assembled by hand (BR-8).
Formal appraisals are not in MVP (BR-7).

request.gloss: give it to me as a PDF

routesElsewhere.note: A report is taken away by the one output route, never by a route of its own (BR-11).

request.text: saari branches ki combined report chahiye
request.gloss: I need the combined report of all branches

routesElsewhere.goesTo: report.combined.run — UC-24-19, the Super Admin alone.
routesElsewhere.note: Every report here is scoped to the branch. One figure across branches is run by the Super Admin, and cannot be given to anybody else.

steps.note: One read. The salary visibility rule is applied before anything is returned (BR-4). The run is recorded (BR-10).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. Without the permission or a month nothing runs; a transfer sheet for a month not yet approved is refused.
plan.atomicity: A read. It changes nothing (BR-9); the only write is the record of the run (BR-10).

operations.name: report.hr.run
operations.purpose: Run a staff or payroll report from the catalogue, with the salary visibility rule applied.

parameters.name: report_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No HR and payroll report this reader may run matches — the catalogue offers only what the role permits.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching reports from the catalogue.

parameters.notes: The report, from the catalogue's HR and payroll group: Staff directory; Headcount by role and branch; Payroll register for the month; Bank transfer sheet; Payslip; Leave balance and leave taken; Staff on leave today; Outstanding staff advances; Joiners and leavers in a period; Appraisals due and completed. Only the reports the reader's role permits are offered.

parameters.name: month
parameters.notes: The month or range the report covers (BR-2, E5).

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The reader. Every run is recorded against them. Never from the request.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: result_id
fields.description: The run. It is taken away with report.export — UC-24-19.

fields.name: parameters
fields.description: The period and scope it ran with, as printed on any output.

fields.name: paged
fields.description: True where the result is paged rather than shown whole.

fields.name: salary_shown
fields.description: Whether this reader may see salary. Where they may not, the column is omitted — not blanked — here and in any file (BR-4).

fields.name: minimum_staffing_met
fields.description: On staff on leave today: whether enough staff remain (BR-6).

fields.name: from_approved_run
fields.description: On the bank transfer sheet: produced from the approved payroll run (BR-8).

errors.meaning: The reader may not see salary.
errors.note: The column is omitted entirely, not blanked (AC-1).

errors.meaning: The payroll run for the month has not been approved.

errors.note: Shown empty and said so — formal appraisals are not yet in use (BR-7).
Shown empty and said so, rather than appearing to have failed.

operations.writesOnRead: The run is recorded — who ran it, which report and over what scope (BR-10).

planningRules.rule: Never put a salary in front of a reader the visibility rule hides it from — not from memory, not from another report, not by arithmetic on what is shown. The column is omitted, not blanked, and the same holds for any file (BR-4, A1, E1, AC-1, AC-2).
Produce the bank transfer sheet only from the approved payroll run. Where the month is not approved it is refused, and never assembled some other way (BR-8, E4, AC-6, AC-7).
Report the minimum-staffing check with staff on leave today, and say that nothing sets the levels it reads (BR-6, OQ-2).
Report appraisals as empty where no records exist, never as nobody being due — formal appraisals are not in MVP (BR-7, E6, AC-9).
Never assume the month. Ask where the request gives none — the reader sets it before the report runs, and a report run over the wrong period is read as though it were the right one.
Never correct anything from a report. A wrong figure is corrected where it was recorded (BR-9, E7, AC-10).
Report an empty result as an answer, not a failure.
Say that the run is recorded, and take the report away only through report.export — UC-24-19, which applies the same salary rule to the file as to the screen (BR-10, BR-11, AC-11).
staff_id and branch_id come from $session. A figure across branches is report.combined.run — the Super Admin's alone.

reversal.statement: A report changes nothing a plan can take back. The record of the run stands (BR-10).

resolvedPlans.context: School Admin, Johar Town. The visibility rule hides salary from the School Admin.
resolvedPlans.outcome: The register without the salary column — omitted, not blanked. Say so, and that any export omits it too.

request.text: November ki bank transfer sheet bana do

resolvedPlans.context: Accounts, Johar Town. November's payroll has not been approved.
resolvedPlans.outcome: Refused: November's payroll has not been approved, and the sheet is produced only from the approved run.

intent.name: payslip.mine.read
intent.summary: Your own payslip and your own leave balance — nothing further.

routesHere.gloss: how many leaves do I have left?

routesHere: show my payslip for last month

routesElsewhere.note: An employee reads their own payslip and no colleague's (BR-5, E3, AC-5).

request.gloss: I want to apply for leave
there is a mistake in my payslip

routesElsewhere.note: A wrong figure is corrected where it was recorded (BR-9). Raise it with Accounts.

plan.atomicity: A read. It changes nothing; the reading is recorded.

operations.name: payslip.mine.read
operations.purpose: Return the employee's own payslip and leave balance.

parameters.name: month
parameters.notes: The month. Omitted, the most recent paid month.

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The employee themselves. Never from the request — there is no parameter for anybody else (BR-5).

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: payslip
fields.description: Earnings, deductions and net pay for the month.

operations.writesOnRead: The reading is recorded, as every report run is (BR-10, AC-11).

planningRules.rule: Only their own. A colleague's payslip is never returned, and there is no way to name one (BR-5, A5, AC-4).
A figure they think is wrong is corrected where it was recorded — never from here (BR-9).

reversal.statement: A read changes nothing a plan can take back. The record of the reading stands (BR-10).

request.gloss: how many leaves do I have left?

resolvedPlans.outcome: Their leave taken and remaining, as the leave records hold it.
